title: The website lab batch poll answers any failure as processing 0 of N, and a batch still being watched is cancelled at one hour with no word to the person
evidence: Superseded (checked 2026-11-26, main 9bccc9ddc): PR 1846 removed the website batch path, its poll and the one-hour watch (app/lib/lab-batches.server.ts, widget-src/src/lib/batch-watch.ts, batch-deadline.ts deleted). The website reads one file per request (app/routes/api.lab-import-v2.ts action); a poll body answers 400 (app/routes/api.lab-import-v2.test.ts 'a poll body is an invalid request'); a failed read is a typed FailReason in the shared upload state (widget-src/src/lib/upload-read.ts). The iPhone never read this poll: it sends to /api/app/v1/lab-read (ios/HealthRoadmap/LabUpload/LabReadSender.swift). Root fix R25 needs no code.
